title: Bell 206 輕型直升機
summary: 以Bell 206輕型旋翼機外形作入門，逐步區分盤面氣動、傳動、機體重量與振動量測；簡單外形不表示系統可忽略。十個單元依序進行機制、定量、量測與診斷，每單元可改一個變數比較結果。
summaryEn: Use the recognizable Bell 206 light-rotorcraft form to distinguish disk aerodynamics, transmission, weight and vibration measurement; a simple outline does not make systems negligible. Ten units each progress through mechanism, calculation, measurement and diagnosis, with a one-variable comparison.
scope: 公開原理支持的原創航空教學。每個數值均明示為假設模型，非同名機型實際性能、維修手冊、製造工藝、取證判據或飛行操作。任務在模型完成，不提供武器、軍用性能最佳化或真機操作指示。
scopeEn: Original aviation teaching based on public principles. Every numerical example is an explicit hypothetical model, not named-aircraft performance, maintenance data, manufacturing process, certification criterion or flight operation. Tasks run in models, excluding weapons, military-performance optimization and aircraft operating instructions.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察
stages.description: 以可核對的機制、算例、操作與診斷逐步建立證據。
stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 盤面推力的物理帳：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Physical ledger of disk thrust: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 盤面推力的物理帳 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Physical ledger of disk thrust and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 理想懸停動量理論以推力、密度和盤面積求誘導速度；葉片輪廓阻力與尾流不均未包含在內。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal hover momentum theory estimates induced velocity from thrust, density and disk area; profile drag and nonuniform wake are excluded.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Bell 206 輕型直升機實際性能或製程：T=1000 N，ρ=1.2 kg/m³，A=10 m²。式 vi=√[T/(2ρA)]，基準結果 6.45497224 m/s。適用條件：理想孤立均勻致動盤、靜止空氣，僅非飛行教育模型。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Bell 206 light helicopter: T=1000 N, rho=1.2 kg/m³ and disk area A=10 m². Formula vi=√[T/(2ρA)] gives 6.45497224 m/s. Conditions: Ideal isolated uniform actuator disk in still air, solely a non-flying educational model.
steps.failure: 把理想誘導功率當整機總功率會低估能量需求。
steps.failureEn: Treating ideal induced power as total aircraft power understates demand.
steps.check: 記錄盤面積和總推力，將誘導功率Tvi與總功率分開，說明輪廓與傳動損失。
steps.checkEn: Record disk area and total thrust, separate Tvi from total power, and identify profile and drivetrain losses.

knowledge.textEn: Ideal hover momentum theory estimates induced velocity from thrust, density and disk area; profile drag and nonuniform wake are excluded.

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 先預測方向，再只把A改成12 m²；其餘條件固定。模型結果由 6.45497224 改為 5.89255651 m/s。在算式區重算並記下對「盤面推力的物理帳」的判讀，以及仍需要哪個量測才能檢驗假設。
knowledge.textEn: Predict the direction, then Change only area A to 12 m², holding other conditions fixed. The model changes from 6.45497224 to 5.89255651 m/s. Recalculate in the expression lab and record what this means for Physical ledger of disk thrust, plus the measurement still needed to test the assumption.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「Bell 206 輕型直升機」的「盤面推力的物理帳：機制與觀察」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出機體、能源、感測、控制與地面驗證的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「風洞值班：把曲線說清楚」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與試件構型、質量或負載表、原始量測與需求版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Physical ledger of disk thrust: Mechanism and observation” in “Bell 206 light helicopter”. Draw the airframe, energy, sensing, control and ground-verification interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Wind-Tunnel Shift: Explain the Curves” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for specimen configuration, mass/load manifest, raw measurements and requirement version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

steps.title: 功率和扭矩的單位：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Units of power and torque: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 功率和扭矩的單位 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Units of power and torque and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 機械功率等於扭矩乘角速度；齒輪改變轉速與扭矩，損失使兩端功率不相等。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical power equals torque times angular speed; gearing changes speed and torque, while losses make input and output power unequal.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非Bell 206 輕型直升機實際性能或製程：P=10000 W，n=1200 rpm。式 T=P/[2πn/60]，基準結果 79.5774715 N·m。適用條件：穩態軸功率、未含扭振或效率，非真機傳動設計。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not measured performance or a process for Bell 206 light helicopter: P=10000 W and n=1200 rpm. Formula T=P/[2πn/60] gives 79.5774715 N·m. Conditions: Steady shaft power without torsional vibration or efficiency; not an operational drivetrain design.
steps.failure: 把rpm直接當rad/s會錯估扭矩；扭矩峰值不能由平均功率完全推出。
steps.failureEn: Treating rpm as rad/s corrupts torque, and average power does not determine peak torque.
steps.check: 確認rpm轉rad/s，將輸入及輸出功率時間對齊以區分暫態儲能。
steps.checkEn: Convert rpm to rad/s and time-align input/output power to distinguish transient energy storage.
